parallels.note: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.
But the goat on which the lot fell for the scapegoat shall be presented alive before Yahweh, to make atonement for him…
You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

translations.web: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
translations.bsb: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
translations.kjv: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement
